title: Addition and Subtraction Word Problems: Unknown Starting Number
intro: Help your student work backward from an ending total to an unknown starting amount.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Build the final collection first. Remove the objects that arrived later and connect what remains to the unknown starting amount.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

Before: an unknown number of books.

Change: 4 books arrive.

After: 13 books.

? + 4 = 13
13 − 4 = 9

There were 9 books on the shelf before Ella arrived.

Ask your student

Are the new objects already included in the final total?

If your student needs help

If the student adds again, show how that would count the arriving objects twice.
